displayName: RPG Runner - payout latency p99 above 15 seconds

documentation.content: The p99 time from durable replay finalize to settlement handoff exceeded 15 seconds. Check validator capacity, replay loading, and deterministic replay duration. The pending-over-15-minutes policy separately covers the post-handoff settlement path.
